name: Kestrel Drift
subtitle: Drone physics simulator · control, wind & payload dynamics
description: Fixed-timestep drone simulator built from scratch to model positioning stability, inertia, gusty wind disturbance and payload ballistics.

details.intro: Kestrel Drift is a custom-built drone simulation project focused on realistic control authority, altitude hold, gust modeling and payload drop validation. The entire physics stack is implemented without external engines, using a force-based motion model and a deterministic update loop.
highlights: Custom quadrotor flight model (angle-mode pitch/roll + altitude hold)
Seed-based gusty wind system with overlapping envelopes
Motor response, inertia and thrust compensation under tilt
Independent payload physics with quadratic drag and ballistic validation presets
Strict simulation/render separation (WorldState as single source of truth)
tech: Custom math utilities (vec2 / vec3 / deterministic RNG)
Action-based input binding system with runtime rebinding

name: Smash!ng Cats
subtitle: Arcade runner · server-authoritative multiplayer architecture
description: Arcade cat runner built on a deterministic server-authoritative core with multiplayer netcode and multiple rendering clients.

details.intro: Smash!ng Cats is a fast arcade cat runner with jumping, smashing, enemies, civilians and chaotic score-driven action. The game is built around a deterministic server-authoritative core, with rendering fully separated from gameplay logic so different clients can visualize the same game state.
highlights: Shared protocol and reusable game packages

name: CatSpin Arena
subtitle: Slot engine · RTP modeling · simulation & strategy testing
description: Config-driven slot engine with deterministic core, RTP modeling and large-scale simulation capabilities.

details.intro: Multiplayer slot system built on a fully deterministic engine with reproducible outcomes, config-driven logic and large-scale simulation capabilities. Supports RTP/volatility modeling, strategy testing and real-time multi-client interaction.
